digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, VI and ch. 5

teaser.en: A 'false' wild yam: so like the edible mriga that its name warns you it isn't the real thing.
teaser.sw: Kiazi kikuu pori 'bandia': kinafanana mno na mriga unaoliwa kiasi kwamba jina lake linakuonya kuwa si wenyewe halisi.
teaser.dg: Mriga wa weruni 'wa handzo': unahalana sana na *mriga* unaoriwa hata dzinare rinakuonya kukala sio mriga wa kpweli.

summary.en: Mriga yere is a wild yam that closely resembles mriga, the edible bitter yam. Its name marks it as the false one. The exact species has not been identified.
summary.sw: Mriga yere ni kiazi kikuu pori kinachofanana sana na mriga, kiazi kikuu chungu kinacholiwa. Jina lake linakionyesha kuwa ndicho cha bandia. Spishi yake kamili haijatambuliwa.
summary.dg: Mriga yere ni mriga wa weruni unaohalana sana na mriga, mriga wa utsungu unaoriwa. Dzinare rinauonyesa kukala ndio wa handzo. Ainaye kamili taidzangbwemanyikana.

about.en: *Mriga yere* is a wild yam, a twining vine that grows from an underground tuber and climbs through bushes each rainy season. Pakia identifies it only to genus, *Dioscorea*. It closely resembles *mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*), the three-leaved bitter yam, which Digo speakers dig as food.
about.sw: *Mriga yere* ni kiazi kikuu pori, mtambaa unaojizungusha ambao huota kutoka kwenye kiazi kilicho chini ya ardhi na hupanda juu ya vichaka kila msimu wa mvua. Pakia anakitambua hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, *Dioscorea*. Kinafanana sana na *mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*), kiazi kikuu chungu chenye majani ya sehemu tatu, ambacho Wadigo hukichimba kwa chakula.
about.dg: *Mriga yere* ni mriga wa weruni, mmea unaodzilinga-linga unaomera kula kpwa chiazi chiricho tsini, na chila wakati wa mvula unaambuka dzulu ya vitsaka. Pakia analavya jenasi tu, *Dioscorea*. Unahalana sana na *mriga* (*Dioscorea dumetorum*), mriga wa utsungu wenye makodza madide mahahu kpwa chila kodza, ambao Adigo anautsimba kpwa chakurya.

where.en: Wild yams grow in coastal bush, thicket and forest edges, climbing over other plants.
where.sw: Viazi vikuu pori huota katika vichaka vya pwani, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu, vikipanda juu ya mimea mingine.
where.dg: Miriga ya weruni inamera weruni pwani, kpwenye vitsaka na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, ichiambuka dzulu ya mimea yanjina.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. Its name sets it apart from the edible *mriga*, and many wild yams are poisonous unless carefully prepared. Wild yams should only be dug and eaten by people who know them well.
uses.sw: Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote. Jina lake linakitenga na *mriga* unaoliwa, na viazi vikuu pori vingi vina sumu visipotayarishwa kwa uangalifu. Viazi vikuu pori vinapaswa kuchimbwa na kuliwa tu na watu wanaovijua vizuri.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi gogosi. Dzinare rinautafwautisha na *mriga* unaoriwa, na miriga minji ya weruni ina sumu ichikala taitengezwa kpwa makini. Miriga ya weruni ni lazima itsimbwe na kuriwa ni atu anaoimanya chikpweli-kpweli tu.

names.en: App. VI translates *mriga yere* as 'false *mriga*', a plant closely resembling the genuine edible *Dioscorea dumetorum*. In his main text, Pakia instead suggests that *mriga yeri* refers to a small type of *mriga*, and says this still needs to be confirmed. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Kiambatisho VI kinatafsiri *mriga yere* kuwa '*mriga* bandia', mmea unaofanana sana na *Dioscorea dumetorum* halisi unaoliwa. Katika maandishi yake makuu, Pakia badala yake anapendekeza kwamba *mriga yeri* inarejelea aina ndogo ya *mriga*, na anasema hili bado linahitaji kuthibitishwa. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: App. VI inatafasiri *mriga yere* dza '*mriga* wa handzo', mmea unaohalana sana na *Dioscorea dumetorum* wa kpweli unaoriwa. Ela kpwenye maandikoge makulu, Pakia anagomba kukala *mriga yeri* inaweza kukala ni aina ndide ya *mriga*, na kukala dzambo hiri bado rinahitaji kuhakikishwa. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.
